title: HRE-luciferase reporter assay after KDM2B siRNA knockdown in normoxia/hypoxia
goal: Measure HIF transcriptional activity in U2OS, MDA-MB-231 and HeLa HRE-luciferase cells after KDM2B depletion with or without 1% O2.

title: HRE-luciferase reporter assay after KDM2B overexpression
goal: Test whether KDM2B overexpression (0.1 or 1 ug plasmid) increases HIF reporter activity in U2OS and HeLa HRE-luciferase cells at 21% O2.

title: qPCR validation of KDM2B siRNA knockdown and HIF-1α/HIF-2α/KDM2B mRNA levels
goal: Confirm KDM2B depletion and measure HIF1A and EPAS1 mRNA levels after KDM2B siRNA in normoxia and hypoxia.

title: Immunoblot of HIF target genes and HIF subunits after KDM2B knockdown
goal: Assess protein levels of CA9, BNIP3, BNIP3L and HIF-1α/2α/1β after KDM2B depletion in normoxia and hypoxia in U2OS and MDA-MB-231 cells.

title: HIF-1α ChIP-qPCR at target gene HREs after KDM2B knockdown
goal: Determine whether KDM2B depletion reduces HIF-1α occupancy at the BNIP3, CA9 and EGLN3 HREs in hypoxia.

title: KDM2B domain-mutant overexpression: HRE-luciferase reporter assay
goal: Determine which KDM2B domains (JmjC, CxxC, PHD, F-box) are required for increasing HIF reporter activity in U2OS and HEK293 HRE-luciferase cells.

title: KDM2B domain-mutant overexpression: immunoblot of HIF-1α and targets
goal: Verify equal expression of KDM2B WT/mutants and assess HIF-1α, CA9, BNIP3 and BNIP3L protein levels in U2OS and HEK293 cells.

title: RNA Pol II ChIP-qPCR at the HIF1A promoter after KDM2B knockdown or domain-mutant overexpression
goal: Test whether KDM2B controls RNA Pol II recruitment to the HIF1A promoter via its JmjC and CxxC domains.

title: Cell proliferation assay after KDM2B knockdown in normoxia and hypoxia
goal: Measure live cell numbers over 96 h in U2OS and MDA-MB-231 cells after KDM2B depletion with or without 1% O2.

title: NF-κB luciferase reporter assay after KDM2B knockdown or overexpression with TNF-α
goal: Assess KDM2B regulation of NF-κB reporter activity and the requirement for JmjC and CxxC domains in U2OS κB-luciferase cells.
